LESSON: JACOB WRESTLES AN ANGEL

Grade: Grade 6
Subject: CHRISTIAN RELIGIOUS EDUCATION
Strand: The Bible
Topic 2.5: Jacob Wrestles an Angel

SECTION 1: WELCOME

Hello! This is a study lesson on Jacob Wrestles an Angel. Read the explanation, follow every worked example, then do the practice. This is original CBC Learn content written from KICD outcomes — not a copy of a commercial textbook.

Big question: how they apply lessons learnt in their lives • compose and say a prayer to God. Why is it good to pray always?

SECTION 2: WHAT YOU WILL LEARN

By the end of this lesson, you will be able to:

1. identify values learnt from the story of Jacob

SECTION 3: STUDY NOTES (READ AND LEARN)

WHAT YOU ARE LEARNING: JACOB WRESTLES AN ANGEL
This lesson teaches Jacob Wrestles an Angel for Grade 6 CHRISTIAN RELIGIOUS EDUCATION.

STUDY STEPS
1. identify values learnt from the story of Jacob
   Practise this until you can do it without help.

HOW TO SHOW UNDERSTANDING
Explain the idea in your own words, give one Kenyan example, then complete the practice tasks.

SECTION 4: QUICK EXAMPLES

Example 1: Describe Jacob Wrestles an Angel using something at your school.

Example 2: Give a home/community example from your county.

Example 3: Teach a younger child one idea from this lesson in simple words.

SECTION 5: PRACTICE NOW

1. Underline the key ideas about Jacob Wrestles an Angel above.
2. Explain Jacob Wrestles an Angel to a parent using one local example.
3. Write or draw three things that prove you understand Jacob Wrestles an Angel.

SECTION 6: WORK TO DO (HOME / REVISION)

1. Write five sentences about Jacob Wrestles an Angel with school or home examples.
2. Answer: Why is Jacob Wrestles an Angel important for a Grade 6 learner?
3. Prepare a one-minute oral presentation for a parent or teacher.

SECTION: THINK ABOUT IT

1. how they apply lessons learnt in their lives • compose and say a prayer to God. Why is it good to pray always?

SECTION: REMEMBER

1. identify values learnt from the story of Jacob

Now complete the Revision Quiz. Open Answers only after you finish.

— CBC Learn · Original study notes from KICD outcomes (Strategy 2)
